'''2017 MPC Charlie Arlandson DS ISB Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Charlie Arlandson]] at [[2017 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

* '''Player:''' [[Charlie Arlandson]]
* '''Event:''' [[2017 Match Play Championship]]
